beats.shot: extreme close-up on a glass bowl
beats.does: A black, tarnished spoon is dropped into steaming hot water with baking soda and foil, instantly fizzing and shining.
beats.says: Don't buy expensive chemical polishes for your tarnished spoons.

beats.does: Harlan holds up a blackened spoon to the camera.
Hands line the glass bowl with a sheet of aluminum foil.
beats.says: But you can clean it easily with everyday items.

beats.does: Hands pour steaming hot water into the foil-lined bowl.
A spoonful of baking soda is dumped into the hot water.
beats.says: And a scoop of baking soda.

beats.does: The tarnished spoon is lowered into the bubbling mixture.
beats.says: The aluminum pulls the tarnish right off.

beats.does: Harlan lifts the now shiny spoon, then raises a glass mug of warm herbal tea toward the camera.

caption: Tired of dull spoons? Try this simple trick to make them shine again! Do you have tarnished silver at home? #EverydayRoots #SilverPolish #CleaningTricks #HomeHacks #ShinySilver
